record.question: Choose the option which is closest in meaning to ingest.
record.explanation: Answer B: to absorb. “Ingest” means take in, especially food or drink; “to absorb” is closest among these. Independent check: To ingest is to take food or another substance into the body; “absorb” is the closest choice. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ingest; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/ingest. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
